body_sample: CLP Researching 中国光学期刊网 光电汇 光品汇 爱光学 游客，您好! 登录 | 免费注册 首页 期刊 文献 学术活动 资讯 视频 知识服务 评选/奖项 搜 索 Chinese Optics Letters, 2026, 24 (6): 061401, Published Online: May. 27, 2026 Copy Citation Text Follow This Article Direction generation of 3 MW peak-power picosecond pulses in a compact all-fiber all-PM CPA-free amplifier Get PDF Full Text 图表 Metrics More Lu Huang 1Kai She 1Jing Sui 1Yikun Bu 1Suya Feng 2,*Zhengqian Luo 1,** Author Affiliations fiber laser amplifier picosecond pulse photonics crystal fiber Abstract We report a 1030 nm all-polarization-maintaining (PM) all-fiber megawatt-peak-power picosecond amplifier without chirped pulse amplification (CPA). The compact fiber picosecond amplifier consists of a 0.8 m long highly Yb-doped photonic crystal fiber (PCF), a home-made 1030 nm all-fiber picosecond seed source, and a 60 W 976 nm pigtailed laser diode.
